method.scope: Actual top-25 Binance spot launch-day data, fixed UTC interpretation of archived dates. The recorded model starts at the first causally available book around 00:00:06. The archive only specifies BTC; adding ETH is a changed strategy configuration.
method.execution: Displayed depth with per-snapshot consumed-size accounting, market buy sized in quote currency including taker fee. Living orders match only opposite aggressive volume printed strictly through their limits, with no repeated allocation of the same observed volume. Queue fills are counterfactual. Use 2x requirement as sensitivity, not additional independent evidence.
method.valuation: Fees .06% maker, .075% taker from the archived backtest. FIFO allocations assign buy/sell fees to closed trades. Open BTC and its costs remain in the mark. Modeled prices already incorporate depth and price impact. Spot has no funding. Equity drawdown is marked at every recorded print. Drawdown percentage fields store decimal fractions.
method.limitations: We do not know the native order queue, hidden depth or historical counterfactual market impact. No order is placed on a real or demo venue.
